statement:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℕ),
  ((∀ (x : ℝ), f (-x) = f x) → iteratedDeriv (2 * k + 1) f 0 = 0) ∧
    ((∀ (x : ℝ), f (-x) = -f x) → iteratedDeriv (2 * k) f 0 = 0)
